## Draft scope for Raydot technical review

Refs #1004, especially [the exact bcd76ae7 Mac acceptance report comment](https://github.com/xinglun/ai-cockpit/issues/1004#issuecomment-6186749658).

This checkpoint contains only new WI-1084 `.ai` planning/governance evidence. **No production code or regression tests have been changed or run.** It does not claim a reproduced RED, fix, formal verification, adopter acceptance or Issue closure.

- Independent worktree/branch from exact main `bcd76ae76f61650a890267f511099c96dc6a47fd`.
- Current canonical Contract: `sha256:507bedef85c7d3cb7ff2b8fd3a885d5441384ea23b8d6e4b010fa9be8c150107`.
- Static path consistent with the report: the recovery validator returns true on a missing receipt; the writer copies the original historical close without an independent persistent recovery-origin dependency. Ordinary historical compatibility makes the surviving close indistinguishable after that single receipt disappears.
- Proposed bounded repair: independent immutable recovery-origin binding plus a versioned required recovery receipt, validated through the shared repository close reader. Preserve historical bytes and existing ordinary-close compatibility. No TTL, Sentinel modification or mechanism rewrite.
- RED plan asserts wrong `closed`/`blocking=false` projection and overlapping admission; status exit 0 is allowed. Cover idempotence, interruption/racing-path preservation, historical not_ready and CLI/MCP parity.

## Actual admission and execution

Prepared start/scaffold succeeded through the repository Runtime. Supported draft amendments recorded the full scope, scenario plans and concurrency boundary. Current Runtime action admission is **needs_human_decision**; ordinary Raydot technical review remains pending and is not human confirmation or human close.

The final formal compatibility read is **compatible=false** because WI-1070 through WI-1074 lack concurrency boundaries/parallel declarations. Registrations and leases remain empty; no extra execution worker or composition started. The proposed fallback is one serial WI-1084 worker while WI-1078 remains Retained under separate review. Do not modify other Work Items merely to manufacture parallel admission.

Review entry: `.ai/evidence/WI-1084-cross-checkout-closeout-receipt-integrity/planning-20261015/raydot-review-draft.md`.
Native observations, rejected/corrected requests, public source responses and SHA-256 manifest are retained beside it. Raw Native human Outcome trailing whitespace is preserved; no Git/hook configuration is changed.

No new-WI human close, PR Ready/merge, branch/worktree deletion, Task9 or WI-1078 resource change is authorized. Keep this PR Draft. No manual CI rerun was triggered for this planning checkpoint.
